coverage.value: Encompass World Partners - encompassworldpartners.org - HIT. Static per-person giving pages at /person/<slug> (also mirrored on give.encompassworldpartners.org/person/<slug>). Slug is usually first-names-only ('mike-and-letitia', 'steveandceleste', 'junko') with the surname and a donor ID in the page TITLE; a minority of newer pages carry the surname in the slug ('malachi-saunders', 'kya-bolding-3057', 'randy-and-susan-clark-3096'). Index at /people (paginated ?page=N) and a roster at /missionaries-giving-list. Mined this run.

World Team - us.worldteam.org / ca.worldteam.org - MISS. A giving index exists at https://us.worldteam.org/give/missionaries/index but no per-person worker page surfaced in any result; everything indexed is pooled giving (/donate-to-missions/, /donate-to-missions/projects/, /give/priorities/). Record the index URL for a future fetch-enabled wave.

HeartCry Missionary Society - heartcrymissionary.com - MISS. No per-missionary page shape at all; indexed surface is /about/... policy and methodology pages plus /employment/. Support is pooled for indigenous missionaries, so there is probably no per-person giving page to find.

Team Expansion - teamexpansion.org - MISS. Giving is routed through two generic pages, /giveonline/globalworkers/ and /giveonline/usworkers/, i.e. a picker/form rather than a page about a person. No /missionaries/<name> shape surfaced.
